newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Banco Caseros suspended for 30 days.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Banco Caseros suspended for 30 days.

text.p: Argentina's central bank said Monday it had suspended the operations of Banco de Caseros SA for 30 days to look into offers received to purchase the troubled institution.
The central bank said it will consider offers by Banco de Credito Argentino SA and Banco de Salta SA to acquire various assets and liabilities of Banco de Caseros.
The central bank added that it will use this time to look into Caseros' assets. It also invited other banks to make offers for the institution.
The offers by Banco Credito and Banco Salta will allow depositors the complete return of their funds or the option to transfer their accounts to the bank that takes over Caseros.
